reviews.review: Good game but I shouldn't need to get DLC to play game modes all my friends have but I don't

I was surprised that this game was actually pretty good, The chapters flow together well, combat is great, though melee combat (a big part of combat) can be difficult if you are not used to having no targeting system (luckily your swings are pretty wide so you will more than likely hit whatever you were going for). Story was decent, maybe even pretty good. Voice acting was good, all emotions I felt were realistic, the ultra marines can come off as cold or emotionless sometimes, but that is how they have always been. Sound design was great however sometimes voices would cut out if you weren't facing the character talking. I would have enjoyed a cover system, granted it is not necessarily needed because of your shield, but there were some fights were I was getting overrun and my only cover was standing behind some boxes and if I moved at all I would have nothing but rockets in my face. I did not play the multiplayer so I can not review that. The Hard difficulty honestly made it hard. I struggled with some areas of fighting, but for the most part I was okay. The only part I was kind of disappointed with is the final boss fight. The area leading up to the final fight between you and him was challenging (basically an enemy rush mode until you kill them all and have to fight him) but the final boss fight is nothing but quick time events. It isn't a bad thing in terms of a boss fight, I enjoyed it in kingdom hearts II, but I feel as a FINAL boss fight, it is kind of a cop out. overall good game. 4 out of 5 stars. It is definitely something that I feel Warhammer fans would like I am not sure how the general public would take it, but it is still a wonderful game either way,

The single player campain is fantastic. Its well paced and has a decient story. That being said it doesnt have a whole lot of replayblitiy in my opinion. 
The multiplayer is extreemly fun both co-op and vs. However there is a lack of infrastructure for multi and the community is somewhat dieing out. It would be great more people played and/or if the new owner (SEGA) added in a few dedicated servers. Easily a 9/10, a must have if its on sale.
The most enjoyable warhammer game I've played that is based aroung playing a single character (as apposed to squad, tabel top or C&C style).

[b]This game is AMAZING![/b]

[b]If you've ever played the first Warhammer 40k: Dawn of war games, you'll LOVE THIS![/b]

[b]- The story line is really good.[/b]
[b]- The combat is really nice and easy to use.[/b]
[b]- Graphics are really nice. (Any computer might be able to run this up medium+)[/b]
[b]- Characters are really likeable.[/b]
[b]------------[/b]
[b]Cons:[/b]
[b]- Due to the company going bankrupt, there will be no sequals. (That I know of.)[/b]

[b]------------[/b]
[b]That's all I can think of. Overall, Great game![/b]

[b]IMO, 8/10.[/b]
